captions.detailed: An astrograph imaging refractor telescope mounted on an equatorial wedge tripod. The optical tube assembly is white with black rings and a blue-tinted front lens, clamped onto a grey dovetail saddle plate. The equatorial wedge is black with a red accents and a gold-colored adjusting bar, supported by three black and silver extendable tripod legs.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an astrograph imaging refractor telescope on a belt-driven equatorial wedge mount. The assembly should feature a white optical tube on a grey saddle plate, a black wedge head with a latitude-adjusting bar, and three adjustable tripod legs that can extend telescopically.
captions.factory: Construct the tripod legs using nested cylinders to simulate extendable prismatic joints. Model the equatorial wedge base using a combination of boxes and cylinders, incorporating a horizontal cylinder for the altitude pivot. Design the right ascension (RA) axis housing with cylindrical segments and a red belt-drive wheel. Build the saddle plate and tube rings using boolean subtractions on box and cylinder primitives, and model the main optical tube as a long white cylinder with a blue-colored lens face.
